name: Obwalden
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Obwalden
summary: Red over white with a double-bearded key in the centre, its colours reversed against each half.
origin: Obwalden and Nidwalden together formed Unterwalden, one of the founding cantons. The key of Saint Peter, patron of the church of Sarnen, is their shared symbol.

symbols.name: Key
symbols.description: A double-bearded key counterchanged red and white.

facts: Obwalden and Nidwalden are counted as half-cantons historically.
The key is shared with Nidwalden's flag.
clues: Red over white with a key in counterchanged colours.
Its key belongs to Saint Peter.
